title: Prabhu tum ho Mashi
lyrics:
Prabhu tum ho Mashi
Prabhu tum ho Jiwan -2
Santi Jiwan data
Sabki paritrata -2
(A)
Tere mahima, tere asish 
Ye asman me bhar chhuke hai -2
Tu asman shristi karta
Sabki palan karta-2
(B)
Tuhi marg, tuhi satya
Tuhi jiwan ye shristika-2
Papiyoka uddharkarta 
Ho teri jay jay kar-2
